positiveEvidence: Current IONITY Italy pricing page publishes Italy IONITY Go at 0.80 EUR/kWh and IONITY Direct at 0.85 EUR/kWh as current minimum prices, explicitly warning that a station price can be higher.
IONITY's official 2026 European price-change explainer publishes Italy subscription prices from 0.48 EUR/kWh and direct/ad-hoc prices up to 0.91 EUR/kWh.
Together these first-party sources prove that current direct/ad-hoc pricing in Italy is not a single nationwide value and may vary by station/location.
negativeEvidence: Do not promote 0.85 EUR/kWh to all IOY EVSE: IONITY explicitly labels it a minimum and publishes direct/ad-hoc prices up to 0.91 EUR/kWh in Italy.
Do not use subscription prices (Power/Motion) as ad-hoc/direct ranking values unless the product context explicitly calls for them.
Do not use ChargeLeague or third-party eMSP pricing as IONITY direct CPO pricing.
